info.name: Returns all pbxes of a customer

params.name: page
params.description: This parameter indicates the page number to begin your query.

params.name: size
params.description: This parameter indicates the page size to begin your query with.  A value between 1 and 100 is supported.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorting strategy.
Sorting can be done for each entity by the name field. Queues can be sorted also by extension.

items.docs: This endpoint returns all the PBXes available for a customer
